 INDIANA (WSBT) — Indiana veterans are being urged to check whether they qualify for expanded property tax relief before the January 15th deadline.
 Governor Mike Braun and the Indiana Department of Veterans Affairs say new legislation eliminates property taxes on primary residences for totally disabled veterans. Legislation also expands tax credits to more than 50,000 additional veterans and surviving spouses.
 Veterans can contact their local veteran service officer to learn more and apply.
